description.value: Freshslice Pizza is a BC-based pizza chain offering pizza by the slice and whole pies with vegetarian options. This New Westminster location sits on the second floor of a building on Carnarvon Street, providing a quick and affordable meal stop for cyclists moving through the downtown core.

bike_parking_detail: 3 racks within 100m: stands (2 spaces) at 72m; stands (2 spaces) at 74m; stands (2 spaces) at 95m. Total: 6 spaces.
